title: Cyrus founds the Persian Empire
description: Cyrus the Great overthrows the Median king Astyages and goes on to build the largest empire the world had yet seen.

title: Darius I takes the throne
description: Darius seizes power and records his victories over rival claimants in the trilingual inscription at Behistun.

title: Building of Persepolis begins
description: Darius I starts the ceremonial capital of the Achaemenid kings.

title: Battle of Gaugamela
description: Alexander defeats Darius III, and the Achaemenid Empire falls to him.

title: Battle of Carrhae
description: Parthian horse archers destroy the Roman army of Crassus.

title: Sasanian Empire founded
description: Ardashir I defeats the last Parthian king and founds the dynasty that rules Iran for four centuries; the site of the battle is uncertain.

title: Valerian captured at Edessa
description: Shapur I defeats a Roman army and takes the emperor prisoner.

title: Battle of al-Qadisiyyah
description: An Arab Muslim army defeats the Sasanians and takes Mesopotamia; the year is given variously between 636 and 638.

title: Battle of Nahavand
description: A second Arab victory opens the Iranian plateau to conquest.

title: Death of Yazdegerd III
description: The last Sasanian king is killed in flight, ending the empire.

title: Shahnameh completed
description: Ferdowsi finishes the epic of Iran's kings, which helps preserve the Persian language.

title: Mongols sack Baghdad
description: Hulagu Khan destroys the Abbasid capital and founds the Ilkhanate, which rules Iran.

title: Safavid dynasty founded
description: Ismail I is crowned shah and makes Twelver Shia Islam the religion of the state.

title: Isfahan becomes the capital
description: Shah Abbas I moves his court to Isfahan and rebuilds it as one of the great cities of the age.

title: Afghans take Isfahan
description: After a siege of more than seven months the Hotaki Afghans capture the capital, and Safavid rule collapses.

title: Treaty of Turkmenchay
description: After a second defeat by Russia, Iran cedes its remaining lands north of the Aras river.

title: Constitutional Revolution
description: Under pressure from protests Mozaffar ad-Din Shah agrees to a parliament, and a constitution follows in December.

title: Oil struck at Masjed Soleyman
description: A British venture makes the first large oil discovery in the Middle East.

title: Coup of 1921
description: The Cossack Brigade under Reza Khan takes Tehran; four years later he is crowned as the first Pahlavi shah.

title: Anglo-Soviet invasion
description: Britain and the Soviet Union occupy Iran to secure oil and supply routes, and Reza Shah abdicates in favour of his son.

title: Oil industry nationalised
description: Parliament votes to nationalise the Anglo-Iranian Oil Company, the policy of Mohammad Mosaddegh.

title: Coup against Mosaddegh
description: A coup backed by the American and British secret services removes the prime minister and restores the shah's power.

title: Khomeini returns
description: Two weeks after the shah leaves the country, Ayatollah Khomeini comes back from exile, and the monarchy falls ten days later.

title: Hostage crisis begins
description: Students seize the American embassy and hold 52 people for 444 days.

title: Iraq invades Iran
description: Saddam Hussein's attack begins a war of eight years that kills hundreds of thousands.

title: Death of Khomeini
description: The founder of the Islamic Republic dies, and Ali Khamenei becomes supreme leader.

title: Nuclear agreement
description: Iran agrees with six powers to limit its nuclear programme in return for relief from sanctions.
